module Hermod.ReCon.Integer.Polynomial.Term

-- | i, j ::= i + i | <a>int</a> · x | <a>int</a>, where <a>int</a> is an

module Hermod.ReCon.Integer.Polynomial.Value

-- | c + k₀ · x₀ + k₁ · x₁ + ... + kₙ · xₙ
data IntTermNF
IntTermNF :: Map VariableIdentifier IntValue -> IntValue -> IntTermNF

-- | Invariant: the coefficients must be non-zero.
[coeff] :: IntTermNF -> Map VariableIdentifier IntValue
[constant] :: IntTermNF -> IntValue
zero :: IntTermNF

-- | (c + k₀ · x₀ + k₁ · x₁ + ... + kₙ · xₙ) + (c' + k₀' · x₀ + k₁' · x₁ +
--   ... + kₙ' · xₙ) = ((c + c') + (k₀ + k₀') · x₀ + (k₁ + k₁') · x₁ + ...
--   + (kₙ + kₙ') · xₙ)
plus :: IntTermNF -> IntTermNF -> IntTermNF
minus :: IntTermNF -> IntTermNF -> IntTermNF

-- | k * (c + k₀ · x₀ + k₁ · x₁ + ... + kₙ · xₙ) = ((k * c) + (k * k₀) · x₀
--   + (k * k₁) · x₁ + ... + (k * kₙ) · xₙ)
mul :: IntValue -> IntTermNF -> IntTermNF
nullify :: VariableIdentifier -> IntTermNF -> IntTermNF
eval :: IntTerm -> IntTermNF
quote :: IntTermNF -> IntTerm
normalise :: IntTerm -> IntTerm
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Hermod.ReCon.Integer.Polynomial.Value.IntTermNF
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.ReCon.Integer.Polynomial.Value.IntTermNF
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.Integer.Polynomial.Value.IntTermNF

module Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula

-- | A property name (e.g. "thread", "node", etc.).
type PropName = Text

-- | The type of variable identifiers used throughout the framework (LTL
--   property variables and polynomial integer variables).
type VariableIdentifier = Text

-- | The numeric type used for integer event property values and polynomial
--   arithmetic throughout the framework.
type IntValue = Int64

-- | Text event property value.
type TextValue = Text

-- | i, j ::= i + i | <a>int</a> · x | <a>int</a>, where <a>int</a> is an
--   arbitrary integer
data IntTerm
IntVar :: IntValue -> VariableIdentifier -> IntTerm
IntConst :: IntValue -> IntTerm
IntSum :: IntTerm -> IntTerm -> IntTerm

-- | Text term: a constant string or a variable ranging over strings.
data TextTerm
TextConst :: TextValue -> TextTerm
TextVar :: VariableIdentifier -> TextTerm

-- | Binary comparison relation on an ordered type.
data BinRel
Eq :: BinRel
Lt :: BinRel
Lte :: BinRel
Gt :: BinRel
Gte :: BinRel

-- | Default name: c. A constraint inside an <a>Atom</a>, matching an event
--   property against a term.
data PropConstraint
IntPropConstraint :: PropName -> IntTerm -> PropConstraint
TextPropConstraint :: PropName -> TextTerm -> PropConstraint

-- | Default name: φ.
--   
--   Formulas of a discrete-time Linear Temporal Logic (LTL) enriched with
--   first-order quantification over event properties.
--   
--   <b>Time model.</b> Time is a sequence of abstract <i>units</i> indexed
--   by natural numbers. Each unit carries a finite multiset of typed
--   events (see <a>Event</a>). The temporal connectives advance through
--   this sequence:
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><tt>◯ φ</tt> — next unit</li>
--   <li><tt>☐ ᪲ₖ φ</tt> — every <tt>(k+1)</tt>-th unit from now,
--   forever</li>
--   <li><tt>☐ⁿ φ</tt> — for each of the next <tt>n</tt> units</li>
--   <li><tt>♢ⁿ φ</tt> — for some unit within the next <tt>n</tt></li>
--   <li><tt>φ |ⁿ ψ</tt> — <tt>φ</tt> until <tt>ψ</tt>, within <tt>n</tt>
--   units</li>
--   </ul>
--   
--   <b>Parameterisation.</b> The type parameter <tt>ty</tt> is the
--   vocabulary of <i>event types</i>; <tt>event</tt> is the concrete event
--   representation (see <a>Event</a>). Atoms (<tt><a>Atom</a> ty cs</tt>)
--   assert that the current unit contains an event of type <tt>ty</tt>
--   whose properties satisfy the constraints <tt>cs</tt>.
--   
--   <b>First-order layer.</b> Quantifiers <tt>∀x ∈ ℤ</tt>, <tt>∃x ∈
--   ℤ</tt>, <tt>∀x ∈ Text</tt>, <tt>∃x ∈ Text</tt>, and their
--   finite-domain variants, bind variables that can appear in property
--   constraints, integer comparison atoms (<tt><a>PropIntBinRel</a></tt>),
--   and text equality atoms (<tt><a>PropTextEq</a></tt>). The resulting
--   fragment is decidable: integer arithmetic is handled by Cooper's
--   quantifier elimination; text quantifiers are decided by finite
--   enumeration (see
--   <a>Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Internal.IR.HomogeneousFormula.FinFree</a>).
data Formula event ty

-- | ☐ ᪲ₖ φ ≡ φ ∧ ◯ (◯ᵏ (☐ ᪲ₖ)) For every (k+1)-th unit of time from now, φ
--   For example: ☐ ᪲₁ φ means for every other unit of time from now, φ ☐
--   ᪲₃ φ means for every 4-th unit of time from now, φ ☐ ᪲₀ φ means for
--   every unit of time from now, φ
Forall :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ☐ⁿ φ ☐⁰ φ ≡ ⊤ ☐¹⁺ᵏ φ ≡ φ ∧ ◯ (☐ᵏ φ) For each of the n units of time
--   from now, φ
ForallN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ♢ⁿ φ ♢⁰ φ ≡ ⊥ ♢¹⁺ᵏ φ ≡ φ ∨ ◯ (♢ᵏ φ) For one of the n units of time
--   from now, φ
ExistsN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ◯ φ For the next unit of time from now, φ.
Next :: Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ◯ⁿ φ ◯⁰ φ ≡ φ ◯¹⁺ᵏ φ ≡ ◯ (◯ᵏ φ) For the n-th unit of time from now, φ
NextN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | φ |ⁿ ψ φ |⁰ ψ ≡ ⊤ φ |¹⁺ᵏ ψ ≡ ψ ∨ ¬ ψ ∧ φ ∧ (φ |ᵏ ψ) φ until ψ in the n
--   units of time from now
UntilN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ty c̄
Atom :: ty -> Set PropConstraint -> Formula event ty

-- | φ ∨ ψ
Or :: Formula event ty -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | φ ∧ ψ
And :: Formula event ty -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ¬ φ
Not :: Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | φ ⇒ ψ
Implies :: Formula event ty -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | T
Top :: Formula event ty

-- | ⊥
Bottom :: Formula event ty

-- | ∀x ∈ ℤ. φ — x ranges over all integers
PropIntForall :: VariableIdentifier -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∀x ∈ Text. φ — x ranges over all strings
PropTextForall :: VariableIdentifier -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∀x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given integers
PropIntForallN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set IntValue -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∀x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given strings
PropTextForallN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set TextValue -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∃x ∈ ℤ. φ — x ranges over all integers
PropIntExists :: VariableIdentifier -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∃x ∈ Text. φ — x ranges over all strings
PropTextExists :: VariableIdentifier -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∃x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given integers
PropIntExistsN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set IntValue -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | ∃x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given strings
PropTextExistsN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set TextValue -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | t rel t (integer)
PropIntBinRel :: BinRel -> Relevance event ty -> IntTerm -> IntTerm -> Formula event ty

-- | t = v (text)
PropTextEq :: Relevance event ty -> TextTerm -> TextValue -> Formula event ty
unfoldForall :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty
unfoldForallN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty
unfoldExistsN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty
unfoldNextN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty
unfoldUntilN :: Word -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | Compute the total <a>Relevance</a> of the formula.
relevance :: (Ord event, Ord ty) => Formula event ty -> Relevance event ty

-- | Set of relevant events.
type Relevance event ty = Set (event, ty)
and :: [Formula event ty] -> Formula event ty

-- | It's useful to express temporal aspect of the formulas in a familiar
--   time unit (e.g milliseconds). Yet, the LTL machinery works with
--   nameless abstract time units. This function can be used to convert one
--   into the other.
interpTimeunit :: (Word -> Word) -> Formula event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | Controls evaluator behaviour when a formula atom references a property
--   key that is absent from the event being evaluated.
--   
--   <ul>
--   <li><a>BottomOnMissingKey</a> — treat the atom as unsatisfied
--   (<tt>⊥</tt>); evaluation continues silently. Useful when events may
--   legally omit optional fields.</li>
--   <li><a>CrashOnMissingKey</a> — throw an exception. Useful during
--   development to catch formula/event-schema mismatches early.</li>
--   </ul>
data OnMissingKey
BottomOnMissingKey :: OnMissingKey
CrashOnMissingKey :: OnMissingKey

-- | Default name: e.
--   
--   Interface between a concrete event representation <tt>a</tt> and the
--   LTL evaluator. The functional dependency <tt>a -&gt; ty</tt> fixes the
--   event-type vocabulary once the event type is known.
--   
--   <b>Semantics.</b> Each time unit presents a sequence of events to the
--   evaluator. An <tt><a>Atom</a> ty cs</tt> is satisfied by unit
--   <tt>t</tt> if there exists an event <tt>e</tt> in <tt>t</tt> such
--   that:
--   
--   <ol>
--   <li><tt><a>ofTy</a> e ty</tt> holds, and</li>
--   <li>every constraint <tt>c ∈ cs</tt> matches <tt>e</tt> against
--   <tt><a>intProps</a> e ty</tt> or <tt><a>textProps</a> e ty</tt> (see
--   <tt>satisfiability-semantics.txt</tt>).</li>
--   </ol>
--   
--   <b>Precondition.</b> <tt><a>intProps</a></tt> and
--   <tt><a>textProps</a></tt> are only called when <tt><a>ofTy</a> e
--   ty</tt> is <tt>True</tt>; their behaviour is unspecified otherwise.
class Event a ty | a -> ty

-- | <tt><a>ofTy</a> e ty</tt> — is event <tt>e</tt> of type <tt>ty</tt>?
ofTy :: Event a ty => a -> ty -> Bool

-- | Integer-valued properties of <tt>e</tt> relevant to type <tt>ty</tt>,
--   keyed by property name. Precondition: <tt><a>ofTy</a> e ty</tt>.
intProps :: Event a ty => a -> ty -> Map VariableIdentifier IntValue

-- | Text-valued properties of <tt>e</tt> relevant to type <tt>ty</tt>,
--   keyed by property name. Precondition: <tt><a>ofTy</a> e ty</tt>.
textProps :: Event a ty => a -> ty -> Map VariableIdentifier TextValue

-- | Timestamp of the event in microseconds. Used for diagnostics only; the
--   LTL evaluator does not reason about wall-clock time.
beg :: Event a ty => a -> Word64
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.TextTerm
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.TextTerm
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.TextTerm
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.PropConstraint
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.PropConstraint
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.PropConstraint
instance (GHC.Classes.Ord ty, GHC.Classes.Ord event) => GHC.Classes.Ord (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.Formula event ty)
instance (GHC.Classes.Eq ty, GHC.Classes.Eq event) => GHC.Classes.Eq (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.Formula event ty)
instance (GHC.Show.Show ty, GHC.Show.Show event) => GHC.Show.Show (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.Formula event ty)

module Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Check

-- | Validate an integer term by checking all of its free variables are
--   bound.
checkIntTerm :: Set VariableIdentifier -> IntTerm -> [Error]

-- | Validate a text term by checking all of its free variables are bound.
checkTextTerm :: Set VariableIdentifier -> TextTerm -> [Error]

-- | Validate a constraint by ensuring its term is well-scoped.
checkParamConstraint :: Set VariableIdentifier -> PropConstraint -> [Error]

-- | Check whether the formula is syntactically valid.
checkFormula :: Set VariableIdentifier -> Formula event ty -> [Error]
data Error
UnboundVariableIdentifier :: VariableIdentifier -> Error
prettyError :: Error -> Text

module Hermod.ReCon.Presburger.Formula

-- | Binary comparison relation on an ordered type.
data BinRel
Eq :: BinRel
Lt :: BinRel
Lte :: BinRel
Gt :: BinRel
Gte :: BinRel

-- | Formulae of Presburger arithmetic — the first-order theory of the
--   integers under addition (<tt>+</tt>), integer constants, and the
--   standard comparison relations (<tt>=</tt>, <tt>&lt;</tt>, <tt>≤</tt>,
--   <tt>&gt;</tt>, <tt>≥</tt>), extended with the divisibility predicate
--   <tt>d | t</tt> ("<tt>d</tt> divides <tt>t</tt>").
--   
--   Quantifiers range over ℤ only. There are no free variables: every
--   well-formed formula is a closed sentence whose truth value is
--   decidable via Cooper's quantifier-elimination procedure
--   (<a>decide</a>).
data Formula

-- | φ ∨ ψ
Or :: Formula -> Formula -> Formula

-- | φ ∧ ψ
And :: Formula -> Formula -> Formula

-- | ¬ φ
Not :: Formula -> Formula

-- | φ ⇒ ψ
Implies :: Formula -> Formula -> Formula

-- | T
Top :: Formula

-- | ⊥
Bottom :: Formula

-- | ∀x : ℤ. φ
IntForall :: VariableIdentifier -> Formula -> Formula

-- | ∃x : ℤ. φ
IntExists :: VariableIdentifier -> Formula -> Formula

-- | i = i | i <a>| i ≤ i | i</a> i | i ≥ i
IntBinRel :: BinRel -> IntTerm -> IntTerm -> Formula

-- | ℕ⁺ | i (divisibility relation, first argument is a non-zero ℕ)
IntDiv :: NatValue -> IntTerm -> Formula
unfoldImplies :: Formula -> Formula -> Formula
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Hermod.ReCon.Presburger.Formula.Formula
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.ReCon.Presburger.Formula.Formula
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.Presburger.Formula.Formula

module Hermod.ReCon.Presburger.Decide

-- | Decide a closed Formula by eliminating all quantifiers and evaluating
--   the resulting ground QuantifierFree formula.
eval :: Formula -> Bool

-- | Embed a Bool into Formula.
quote :: Bool -> Formula

module Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Satisfy

-- | The result of checking satisfaction of a formula against a timeline.
--   If unsatisfied, stores points in the timeline "relevant" to the
--   formula.
data SatisfactionResult event ty
Satisfied :: SatisfactionResult event ty
Unsatisfied :: Relevance event ty -> SatisfactionResult event ty

-- | Check if the formula is satisfied in the given event timeline.
satisfies :: (Event event ty, Ord event, Ord ty, Show ty, Foldable f) => OnMissingKey -> Formula event ty -> f event -> SatisfactionResult event ty

-- | Given a formula and a stream of events, forms an <a>IO</a> computation
--   that returns a <a>SatisfactionResult</a> once the formula is
--   equivalent to ⊤ or ⊥. This may happen either once the stream
--   terminates or if the formula is falsified early by some prefix of the
--   stream.
satisfiesS :: (Event event ty, Ord event, Ord ty, Show ty) => OnMissingKey -> Formula event ty -> Stream (Of event) IO () -> IORef (SatisfyMetrics event ty) -> IO (SatisfactionResult event ty)
data SatisfyMetrics event ty
SatisfyMetrics :: Word64 -> Formula event ty -> Word64 -> SatisfyMetrics event ty
[eventsConsumed] :: SatisfyMetrics event ty -> Word64
[currentFormula] :: SatisfyMetrics event ty -> Formula event ty

-- | μs
[currentTimestamp] :: SatisfyMetrics event ty -> Word64
instance (GHC.Classes.Eq event, GHC.Classes.Eq ty) => GHC.Classes.Eq (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Satisfy.SatisfactionResult event ty)
instance (GHC.Show.Show event, GHC.Show.Show ty) => GHC.Show.Show (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Satisfy.SatisfactionResult event ty)

module Hermod.ReCon.LTL.ContinuousFormula

-- | Default name: φ.
--   
--   The continuous counterpart of <a>Formula</a>: all temporal connectives
--   are absent. A <a>ContinuousFormula</a> is evaluated against a
--   <i>single</i> event (or time unit) rather than a sequence, making it a
--   purely propositional / first-order assertion about the present moment.
data ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ty c̄
Atom :: ty -> Set PropConstraint -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | φ ∨ ψ
Or :: ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | φ ∧ ψ
And :: ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ¬ φ
Not :: ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | φ ⇒ ψ
Implies :: ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ⊤
Top :: ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ⊥
Bottom :: ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∀x ∈ ℤ. φ — x ranges over all integers
PropIntForall :: VariableIdentifier -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∀x ∈ Text. φ — x ranges over all strings
PropTextForall :: VariableIdentifier -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∀x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given integers
PropIntForallN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set IntValue -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∀x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given strings
PropTextForallN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set TextValue -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∃x ∈ ℤ. φ — x ranges over all integers
PropIntExists :: VariableIdentifier -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∃x ∈ Text. φ — x ranges over all strings
PropTextExists :: VariableIdentifier -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∃x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given integers
PropIntExistsN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set IntValue -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | ∃x ∈ v̄. φ — x ranges over the given strings
PropTextExistsN :: VariableIdentifier -> Set TextValue -> ContinuousFormula ty -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | t rel t (integer)
PropIntBinRel :: BinRel -> IntTerm -> IntTerm -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | t = v (text)
PropTextEq :: TextTerm -> TextValue -> ContinuousFormula ty

-- | Retract a <a>Formula</a> into a <a>ContinuousFormula</a>, returning
--   <a>Nothing</a> if the formula contains any temporal connective.
retract :: Formula event ty -> Maybe (ContinuousFormula ty)

-- | Algorithm for (e ⊧ φ): checks each <a>Atom</a> against the event type
--   and substitutes property constraints with the event's concrete values,
--   yielding a <a>HomogeneousFormula</a> ready for decision.
interp :: (Event event ty, Eq ty) => ContinuousFormula ty -> event -> Reader OnMissingKey HomogeneousFormula

-- | Decide (e ⊧ φ).
eval :: (Event event ty, Eq ty) => ContinuousFormula ty -> event -> Reader OnMissingKey Bool
instance GHC.Classes.Ord ty => GHC.Classes.Ord (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.ContinuousFormula.ContinuousFormula ty)
instance GHC.Classes.Eq ty => GHC.Classes.Eq (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.ContinuousFormula.ContinuousFormula ty)
instance GHC.Show.Show ty => GHC.Show.Show (Hermod.ReCon.LTL.ContinuousFormula.ContinuousFormula ty)

module Hermod.ReCon.Presburger.Parser
type Parser = Parsec Void Text

-- | Parse a Presburger arithmetic formula.
--   
--   Precedence table (outermost / lowest binding first):
--   
--   <pre>
--   ∀x. φ   ∃x. φ     quantifiers
--   φ ⇒ ψ             implication (right-associative)
--   φ ∨ ψ             disjunction (right-associative)
--   φ ∧ ψ             conjunction (right-associative)
--   ¬ φ               negation    (prefix, binds to single atom)
--   ⊥  ⊤  (φ)  d∣t  t rel t     atoms
--   </pre>
--   
--   Note: to combine a quantifier with a connective write <tt>φ ∧ (∀x.
--   ψ)</tt> — quantifiers inside sub-formulas must be parenthesised.
formula :: Parser Formula

-- | Full IntTerm: atoms joined by <tt>+</tt> and <tt>-</tt>.
intTerm :: Parser IntTerm

mkIngestor :: Int -> IO Ingestor
mkIngestorReader :: Ingestor -> IO IngestorReader
ingestFileThreaded :: Ingestor -> FailureMode -> IngestMode -> FilePath -> IO (Maybe String)

instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Ingest.IngestMode
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Ingest.FailureMode
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Ingest.FailureMode
instance Data.Aeson.Types.FromJSON.FromJSON Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Ingest.Timestamp

module Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Feed

-- | Temporal event represents multiple trace messages spanning some
--   duration of time together with an index of the event.
data TemporalEvent
TemporalEvent :: Word64 -> [TraceMessage] -> TemporalEvent

-- | Microseconds since epoch when the event begins.
[beg] :: TemporalEvent -> Word64
[messages] :: TemporalEvent -> [TraceMessage]

-- | For performance considerations we group trace messages within the
--   specified duration in one <a>TemporalEvent</a>.
type TemporalEventDurationMicrosec = Word
read :: FilePath -> TemporalEventDurationMicrosec -> IO [TemporalEvent]
readS :: IngestorReader -> TemporalEventDurationMicrosec -> Stream (Of TemporalEvent) IO ()
instance GHC.Classes.Ord Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Feed.TemporalEvent
instance GHC.Classes.Eq Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Feed.TemporalEvent
instance GHC.Show.Show Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Feed.TemporalEvent

module Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Event
class Extractable a
extract :: Extractable a => Value -> Maybe a
extractProps :: Extractable a => Object -> Map VariableIdentifier a
instance Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Event.Extractable Hermod.ReCon.Common.Types.IntValue
instance Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Event.Extractable Data.Text.Internal.Text
instance Hermod.ReCon.LTL.Formula.Event Hermod.ReCon.Trace.Feed.TemporalEvent Data.Text.Internal.Text
